The issue is caused by a typo in the configuration file `configs/_base_/models/ocrnet_r50-d8.py`. Specifically, the keyword `drop_out_ratio` is used in the `decode_head` definitions for both `FCNHead` (line 26) and `OCRHead` (line 38).

The `FCNHead` class in `mmseg/models/decode_heads/fcn_head.py` inherits from `BaseDecodeHead`. When the model is built via `mmseg/models/builder.py::build_head`, the configuration dictionary is passed to the `FCNHead.__init__` method. Since `FCNHead.__init__` captures unknown arguments via `**kwargs` and passes them to `super(FCNHead, self).__init__(**kwargs)`, the error occurs because the underlying `BaseDecodeHead` (or the registry-based instantiation process) does not recognize the argument name `drop_out_ratio`.

To resolve this, you must rename the parameter in `configs/_base_/models/ocrnet_r50-d8.py`:
- Change `drop_out_ratio=0.1` to `dropout_ratio=0.1` at line 26.
- Change `drop_out_ratio=0.1` to `dropout_ratio=0.1` at line 38.
